text.p: Roche Holding AG said it expected good results for the current year, including an increase in the group net profit.

"We expect another good result and an increase in profit for 1997 under the normal, but necessary condition that there are no unforeseen events," Roche chairman Fritz Gerber said in a speech prepared for a news conference.
Gerber said the size of the profit increase in 1997 would mainly depend on which new products Roche would bring onto the market this year.
"You must be aware that the introduction of new approved products is connected with considerable investments..." which has a short-term effect of the size of the profit increase," Gerber said.
Earlier Roche had said in its 1996 annual report that it also expected another good result in 1997.

"Barring extraordinary events, we expect to post another good year result for 1997 despite the high levels of investment referred to above for the introduction of new products," Roche said in its 1996 annual report.
Roche last month reported that 1996 group net profit rose 16 percent to 3.90 billion francs from 3.37 billion in 1995. Group sales rose 10.7 percent to 15.966 billion.
